Bots' progress goes to a Work section, so a group chat shows answers, not every step a bot takes on the way.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.13.exe`** below and run it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** If you download the installer in a browser, Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. The one-command install doesn't get that prompt.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Changes

- **Work section.** What a bot writes before it uses a tool (its progress) no longer appears in the group chat as it is written. It goes to a **Work** button in the group header, grouped per bot. The chat gets each bot's answer once, when its turn ends.
- **Quieter groups.** A bot's live typing bubble shows dots only. Partial text stays out of the chat until the answer is posted.
- **Teammates still get woken.** A progress note that names a teammate still wakes that teammate, and the teammate gets the note in its prompt.
- **Bots post on purpose.** A bot posts an intermediate step to the group only when it has to reach the group now (a decision, a blocker, a question). Everything else stays in Work.
- **Slower rounds in busy groups.** A bot holds the group until its answer is posted, so the next bot starts after it, not after its first sentence.
- **Groups on the VM.** Work notes sync with the group, so a group that runs on the VM shows its Work on every device.
- **Runner fix.** A group that moves to the VM runner no longer answers its old messages again.

## Older versions

Install 1.8.13 on every computer that opens a group. An older app still posts progress into the chat.
